info.title: Horse Dataset Annotation Service
info.description: Draft Go service contract. Internal HTTP API behind FastAPI. Owns annotation tasks, revisions, review and accepted snapshots. Business rules and delivery criteria: ../go-annotation-service-spec.md. All project mutations require idempotent request_id; no application implementation is included.

Box.description: Coordinates are in working-image pixels. The service additionally checks finite values, positive area, image bounds, allowed labels and unique box IDs.

CreateTaskRequest.description: Trusted gateway request. The platform resolves image metadata and validates the assignee/reviewer. Image versions and label schema are immutable after creation. Task item IDs are generated by Go and obtained through the items endpoint.

TaskItemContext.description: Go response contains no S3 URL. The platform adds a fresh viewing URL and expiry for the browser after obtaining this authorized context.

ReviewCommentInput.description: Use null targets for a general task comment. A box target requires an item target and must belong to the pinned submission revision.
